title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Hainan's Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening Up
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Hainan's Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening Up

Fa Fa [2018] No. 16

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, earnestly implement the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core regarding support for Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, give full play to the functional role of the people's courts, and promote the construction of the Hainan Pilot Free Trade Zone and a Free Trade Port with Chinese characteristics, these opinions are formulated in accordance with the "Guiding Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Supporting Hainan's Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening Up" and the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Construction of Pilot Free Trade Zones."

I. Earnestly Improve Political Position and Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission in Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Hainan's Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening Up

1. Deeply understand the significant significance of Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, and further clarify the historical mission shouldered by the people's courts. Against the backdrop of socialism with Chinese characteristics entering a new era, entrusting the Hainan Special Economic Zone with new reform and opening up missions is a major national strategy personally planned, deployed, and promoted by General Secretary Xi Jinping. It is conducive to perfecting and developing the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, accelerating the formation of a new pattern of comprehensive opening up, and building Hainan into a new highlight of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as a guide, adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, adhere to the new development philosophy, accurately grasp the guiding ideology, strategic positioning, basic principles, and development goals of Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, fully utilize judicial functions, adjudicate related cases fairly and efficiently in accordance with the law, deepen the reform of the judicial system, strengthen the construction of smart courts, continuously improve judicial capabilities and levels, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for building Hainan into a pilot zone for comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, a national pilot zone for ecological civilization, an international tourism consumption center, and a service guarantee area for major national strategies.

2. Identify the entry points and integration points for providing judicial services and guarantees for Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up. Adhere to the rule of law thinking, focus on key areas in serving and guaranteeing Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, earnestly study new situations and solve new problems, promptly formulate judicial policies, issue judicial interpretations, and improve working mechanisms to ensure that decisions are scientific and implementation is effective. Enhance the overall situation awareness, establish and improve unified coordination mechanisms, give full play to the functional role of the First Circuit Court of the Supreme People's Court, and ensure that all work is coordinated and efficient. Improve the trial mechanism, innovate working methods, improve trial quality and efficiency, refine adjudication rules, unify adjudication standards, and effectively improve the ability and level of judicial services and guarantees.

II. Give Full Play to Judicial Functions to Promote Hainan in Building a Legal, International, and Convenient Business Environment and a Fair, Open, and Unified Market Environment

3. Strengthen criminal trials and severely crack down on all types of criminal offenses affecting Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up. Punish all types of criminal offenses in accordance with the law, especially economic crimes such as smuggling, money laundering, tax evasion, and illegal fundraising involving key areas of Hainan's reform and opening up, maintain market order, and ensure social stability.

4. Strengthen administrative trials and legally support the transformation of government functions. Support Hainan courts in exploring cross-regional centralized jurisdiction over administrative cases, legally serve and guarantee the reform of the administrative system, promote the deepening of reforms to streamline administration, delegate power, improve regulation, and optimize services, and assist the government in enhancing governance capabilities. Legally support the pilot free trade zone and free trade port in implementing high-level trade and investment liberalization and facilitation policies, and fully implement the pre-establishment national treatment plus negative list management system for foreign investment. Legally adjudicate administrative cases within the pilot free trade zone concerning people's livelihood and social security, domestic and foreign trade, investment and financing, fiscal taxation, financial innovation, and entry-exit management, serving the construction of a more flexible policy system, regulatory model, and management system.

5. Strengthen civil and commercial trials to serve the construction of a modern economic system. Strengthen property rights protection and legally support the construction of government integrity and the business environment. Legally adjudicate cases of unfair competition and monopoly to maintain a unified market and fair competition. Legally adjudicate cases involving agricultural reclamation projects and state-owned farm reforms to promote the corporatization of reclamation areas and farm reforms. Properly handle cases related to rural land expropriation, the entry of collective operational construction land into the market, and the reform of the homestead system, serving the implementation of relevant reform policies. Legally adjudicate civil and commercial cases in key open areas such as the seed industry, medical care, education, sports, telecommunications, the Internet, culture, maintenance, finance, and shipping, promoting the opening up of modern agriculture, high-tech industries, and modern service industries. Legally adjudicate contract dispute cases to promote fair transactions. Legally adjudicate company dispute cases to encourage market entities and social entities to innovate and start businesses. Legally adjudicate military-related cases to promote the integrated development of military and civilian sectors.

6. Strengthen maritime trials to serve the strategy of building a maritime power. Explore and innovate maritime trial mechanisms, and legally exercise judicial jurisdiction over the sea areas under China's jurisdiction. Innovate the trial work for maritime rights protection, actively and steadily adjudicate maritime cases involving key infrastructure construction such as shipping, fisheries, maritime salvage, and offshore energy reserves, strengthen rights protection in the South China Sea, and support the construction of the service guarantee area for major national strategies. Legally adjudicate cases concerning cruise transportation, the construction of islands and reefs in the South China Sea, marine environmental protection, the development of marine resources, and the safety of maritime passages, support the construction of modern marine ranches, promote the development of the marine economy, protect the marine ecological environment, and safeguard national maritime rights and interests.

7. Strengthen intellectual property trials to serve the innovation-driven development strategy. Legally adjudicate intellectual property cases involving fields such as aerospace technology and deep-sea technology, supporting Hainan in building a major scientific and technological innovation base in the aerospace field and the Southern Center of the National Deep Sea Base. Properly handle cases involving new plant varieties, guarantee the construction of the national wintering breeding base for scientific research, and support Hainan in building a national tropical agricultural science center and a global base for the introduction and transit of animal and plant germplasm resources. Properly handle intellectual property cases involving new medical technologies, equipment, and drugs, providing judicial services and guarantees for the construction of the Boao Lecheng International Medical Tourism Pilot Zone. Legally adjudicate intellectual property cases involving digital industries such as online culture, games and animation, film and television production, virtual reality, and e-sports, promoting the development of the digital creative industry. Deepen reforms in the field of intellectual property trials, support Hainan in establishing an intellectual property tribunal, support the construction of the China (Hainan) International Intellectual Property Exchange, and better play the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property.

8. Legally adjudicate financial cases to serve the prevention and control of financial risks. Legally adjudicate cases involving loan guarantee disputes, bill disputes, trust disputes, etc., properly handle financial disputes arising from asset management and other matters, prevent and resolve financial risks, regulate financial innovation behavior, maintain financial market order, and promote the healthy development of the financial industry. Legally adjudicate foreign-related financial cases, accurately determine the legal effect of cross-border investment behaviors that circumvent the national foreign exchange control policies. Legally adjudicate Internet financial dispute cases to regulate the development of Internet finance. Legally adjudicate new types of financial cases involving independent guarantees, new types of financing, cross-border guarantees, foreign-invested investment banks, insurance, securities, and other financial fields, as well as RMB business and other new types of financial cases, promoting investment and financing innovation and the internationalization of the RMB.

9. Legally and properly handle tourism disputes, support Hainan in improving the quality of tourism consumption services, and promote the internationalization of tourism consumption. Establish a centralized trial mechanism for tourism disputes, explore summary procedures for international tourism disputes, properly adjudicate tourism contract disputes and tort disputes in accordance with legal provisions and with reference to internationally accepted rules, promote the internationalization, standardization, and informatization of tourism facilities and elements, and provide judicial services and guarantees for Hainan's construction of an international tourism consumption center.

10. Strengthen environmental resource trials, using the strictest systems and the strictest rule of law to protect the ecological environment. Adhere to the concept of "green, circular, and low-carbon," adapt to the actual needs of the construction of the national pilot zone for ecological civilization, and promote innovation in the environmental judicial system and mechanism. Legally adjudicate disputes over ownership of natural resources, maintain the order of resource development and utilization, and regulate the system of natural resource transaction and transfer. Implement the requirements of the reform of the ecological environment supervision system, legally adjudicate cases such as the registration of rights confirmation for natural ecological spaces, promote the implementation of the system for confirming and registering rights over natural resources, and strengthen the protection of state-owned natural resource property rights. Give full play to the educational and guiding function of the judiciary, increase the publicity of environmental justice, cultivate public awareness of ecological and environmental protection, and promote the formation of a simple, moderate, green, and low-carbon production and lifestyle.

11. Strengthen foreign-related commercial trials to promote the formation of a new pattern of comprehensive opening up. Innovate trial methods for foreign-related commercial cases, improve litigation procedures such as service of process, notarization, and apostille, broaden the channels for ascertaining foreign law, correctly apply conflict of law rules, accurately apply international treaties, international practices, and foreign laws, strengthen judicial assistance, legally recognize and enforce foreign civil and commercial judgments and foreign arbitral awards, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, effectively maintain international transaction order, and promote the establishment of a new open economic system.

12. Strengthen research on forward-looking issues and properly adjudicate new types of cases. Legally adjudicate cases involving international energy, shipping, bulk commodities, property rights, equity, carbon emission rights, etc., promoting the healthy development of new types of transaction models. Legally adjudicate new types of cases such as paid use of natural resources and forest management, supporting Hainan's pioneering exploration in establishing and improving the property rights system for natural resource assets and the paid use system. Legally adjudicate new types of cases involving the securitization of intellectual property, intellectual property credit guarantees, quiz-type sports lotteries and instant lottery tickets for large international events, providing high-quality and efficient judicial services for the reform and innovation of the pilot free trade zone and the free trade port.

13. Strengthen enforcement work to ensure that the winning parties realize their rights and interests in a timely manner. On the basis of advancing the "basic resolution of enforcement difficulties," further optimize the long-term mechanism for enforcement, change enforcement management methods, innovate enforcement work methods, and strengthen the standardization of enforcement. Increase joint punishment for dishonesty and promote the construction of the social credit system.

III. Support the Establishment of Diversified International Commercial Dispute Resolution Institutions and Give Full Play to the Role of Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanisms

14. Support the establishment of international dispute mediation institutions and give full play to the role of mediation in international commercial dispute resolution. Improve the construction of litigation-mediation docking platforms, fully utilize modern information technology, carry out online mediation and online judicial confirmation, and confirm the validity of mediation agreements in accordance with the law. Strengthen the construction of a "one-stop" dispute resolution mechanism, especially in areas such as tourism, elderly care, road traffic, medical and health, and foreign-related commerce, give full play to the functions of various mediation organizations, actively carry out lawyer participation in mediation, and give full play to the role of lawyers in international commercial mediation.

15. Support the establishment of international commercial arbitration institutions and fully respect the parties' willingness to choose dispute resolution methods. If the parties to civil and commercial cases in the pilot free trade zone or free trade port agree to submit the dispute to foreign arbitration, it should not be deemed invalid on the grounds that there are no foreign-related elements. If a party applies to the people's court for enforcement, the people's court shall handle it in accordance with the provisions of Article 283 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

16. Improve the dispute resolution mechanism for the rights and interests of cross-border e-commerce consumers, and legally safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of cross-border e-commerce consumers. If a cross-border e-commerce platform operator uses standard terms to conclude an arbitration agreement with a consumer without taking reasonable measures to remind the consumer, and the consumer requests confirmation that the arbitration agreement is invalid, the people's court shall support it.

17. Establish a centralized trial mechanism for international commercial dispute cases. Concentrate high-quality resources, legally adjudicate international commercial dispute cases involving the construction of the pilot free trade zone and the free trade port, and improve the ability and level of case adjudication.

IV. Strengthen the Construction of Smart Courts and Use Information Technology to Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Case Trials

18. Comprehensively build smart courts and improve the informatization level of judicial services and guarantees. Highlight the characteristics of informatization, adapt to the social development and changes of the new era and the judicial needs of the people, support the pilot of judicial intelligence construction in Hainan, promote the deep integration of modern technology and court work, promote the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity, and make the judicial service and guarantee capacity match the new requirements of Hainan's comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up.

V. Deepen the Reform of the Judicial System and Ensure That All Reform Deployments Are Implemented and Effective

19. Strengthen the construction of the trial system. In accordance with the reform plan for the Party and state institutions, combined with the requirements of Hainan's administrative division reform and innovation, actively explore judicial system reforms that are compatible with administrative system reforms. In accordance with the principles of optimization, coordination, and efficiency, solidly promote the reform of internal court institutions. Support the construction of maritime circuit courts and island trial sites, and establish a more convenient and efficient litigation mechanism that meets the needs of the pilot free trade zone and the free trade port.

20. Deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system. Further improve the judge quota system, improve the mechanisms for selecting, supplementing, withdrawing, and exchanging quota judges, and realize the normalization and institutionalization of the entry and exit of quota judges. Improve the judge training, assessment, and disciplinary mechanisms, actively promote the reform of the job sequence for judge assistants and court clerks and the reform of the management system for employed court clerks, strengthen the allocation and management of trial support personnel, and comprehensively improve the standardization, specialization, and professionalism of the court team.

VI. Strengthen the Construction of the Talent Team and Provide Intellectual Support for Trial Work

21. Innovate talent training models. In combination with the actual work of the people's courts, build a more open talent training, introduction, and exchange mechanism, actively explore and reform the talent training and reserve mechanism, strengthen training for judges in professional knowledge such as investment, finance, trade, and shipping, and focus on cultivating high-level trial talents with international vision, knowledge of international rules, and proficiency in foreign languages.

VII. Strengthen International Exchange and Cooperation to Enhance the International Influence of China's Judiciary

22. Actively carry out international exchanges and cooperation to establish a good image of the rule of law in China. Give full play to the window role of the pilot free trade zone and strengthen international judicial exchanges and cooperation. Support judges in the pilot free trade zone in conducting foreign exchanges, participating in foreign-related training, and participating in related international conferences, showcase the achievements of China's rule of law construction, enhance the international community's understanding of China's judicial work in pilot free trade zones, and enhance the international influence of China's judiciary.

August 1, 2018
